_meta.purpose: Per-STRUCTURE placement only (host chambers + mode). There is deliberately no per-lesion section: diagnosis->anatomy is LEARNED from the painted corpus in utils/mullins_corpus.py, not declared here. Only 8 of the 87 structures need an entry; the rest fall through to name-token heuristics in mullins_segmap._placement(). Placement mode is itself derivable from where a donor's region sits relative to the septum and chambers, so this file should shrink further, not grow.

components._note: Placement per composable structure. The composer consults this first, then falls back to name-token heuristics. host=base chambers it occupies; mode=defect(keep small, sit on septum) | replace(area-match to host) | add(vessel over background).

VSD.note: perimembranous default; a hole in the interventricular septum between the two ventricles

ASD.note: secundum default; a hole in the interatrial septum
